messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: Elevated 5xx + timeouts from gateway reported for /v1/generate across multiple regions. p95 and p99 for the last 5m spiked — alert group: infra/p95-timeout.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-14T15:20UTC to canary (svc-inference:v2.4.1) completed at 15:21 UTC. Canary routed 5% traffic.
alex: I'm on it, joining. Seeing client timeouts in APAC and EU from the first canary minute.
maya: Confirmed — dashboards show p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s, p99 ~6s. Error rate 5xx up ~4x.
jordan: Any recent config flips? Autoscaling? KV cache toggles?
alex: I checked infra-autoscale — no changes. Deploy-bot, what changed in v2.4.1?
deploy-bot: v2.4.1 changelog: batching refactor, new attention kernel selection, prefix cache refactor.
sam: Batching refactor rings alarm bells — aggressive group size maybe increasing serialization latency for short requests.
lee: Logs show repeated "gateway timeout waiting for model" from runtime pool. Stack: runtime-proxy -> runtime-worker -> model-server.
maya: Quick repro: curl to canary endpoint returns intermittent 504s, with server-side logs showing long stalls in KV lookup: `kv_cache.get(key) took 2500ms`.
alex: Can we reduce canary traffic to 0% and roll back? Priority: customer impact down.
jordan: Agreed. If canary is the root, rollback canary to v2.4.0.
alex: Taking action: `kubectl rollout undo deploy svc-inference --to-revision=v2.4.0` (canary slice only) — running now.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for canary slice. Estimated completion ~45s.
maya: Start mitigation timeline for customers: affected requests primarily short prompt patterns (<=64 tokens) where batching overhead dominates. Impact if you use sync inference via hosted API.
pm-elena: I'll draft a status update for customers: brief outage note + mitigation steps and ETA.
sam: While rollback happening, let's enable per-request timeouts on gateway to fail fast and avoid pileups: set proxy timeout to 3s for inference route.
lee: Applied gateway override: `route.timeout=3s` for /v1/generate in EU/APAC. Monitoring p95 for the route now.
alex: Rollback finished. Canary now on v2.4.0. Observability: p95 dropping back to ~140ms in EU, APAC slowly following. Error rate trending down.
maya: Verified — past 2m p99 back to ~400ms, 5xx rate falling to baseline. No user-facing lasting errors in NA.
jordan: Great. Capture root cause hypothesis: batching refactor + KV prefix refactor caused occasional blocking on KV lookups for short requests; combined with canary routing created resource contention.
sam: Next steps: revert batching refactor in master branch pending deeper perf test, include unit/integration for KV lookup latency.
pm-elena: Customer update posted to status page: "Partial increase in errors and timeouts for short inference requests in EU/APAC following a canary deploy; rollback completed and traffic restored. Investigating root cause." (link)
alex: Handing off to oncall rotation for post-rollback monitoring and postmortem. @jordan take point for the next 8h?
jordan: I got it. I'll run a focused perf harness overnight to reproduce and collect traces.
maya: I'll add evals comparing v2.4.1 vs v2.4.0 on short prompt distribution and attach flamegraphs.
sam: Add regression alert to PR checks to catch p95 increases > 25% vs baseline for canary runs.
lee: Collected a snippet of suspicious stack traces: ```
runtime-worker[pid=42]: waiting on kv_cache::get prefix_id=0x3b9f, elapsed=2380ms
model-server: blocking on prefix deserialization
``` 
alex: Good capture. Tag as high priority for infra-ml. Set follow-up ticket: INF-3271.
jordan: Creating INF-3271 with logs, traces, and repro steps. Assigning to @maya and @lee.
pm-elena: Notifying top 5 affected customers via account success with incident summary and expected follow-up.
inc-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-148 — "Post-deploy latency and timeout spike; canary rollback". Severity: Sev2.
alex: Closing live mitigation loop: rollback succeeded, gateway override applied, status page updated, customers notified. Leaving monitoring for 30m.
jordan: Handoff notes for next oncall: monitor p95/p99 globally, watch KV get latency metric `kv.get.latency.p99`, and validate canary tests can't reproduce.
maya: I'll schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Agenda: timeline, root cause, tests to add, rollout policy changes (canary % ramp and perf gates).
sam: Quick follow: proposal to add synthetic short-prompt workload in CI canary stage and require p95 regression < 10% before canary ramp.
lee: Also suggest adding a graceful degradation path: if kv lookup > 500ms, fallback to stale cache or skip batching for that request class.
jordan: Acknowledged. I'm taking the handoff. Ping if anything flares.
inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-148 auto-escalation scheduled in 2h if unresolved.
pm-elena: Thanks team — succinct customer postmortem after root cause confirmed. :heart:
